name: Pearlie
description: Self-hosted media hub: browse Stash, Komga and booru or nhentai sites, and save into Stash and Komga with tag filters.

notes.text: Pearlie has no login of its own: reach it only over Tailscale or a reverse proxy with login.
API keys are entered on the Options page after install; they are stored encrypted and never shown.
Update from Options > System, or run `pearlie-update` inside the container.
